Message:
The seed failed to
reach full bloom,
but the results of its budding
were more than enough
to prove my hypothesis.

Meria gained control
over the demon’s power,
making it her own.

Which only proves beyond
a shadow of a doubt that
higher beings and humans
share the same roots.

Now that I’ve verified as much,
there’s no reason to keep Meria
at the Academy any longer.

After all,
I’ve discovered an even more
fascinating subject...

The wielder of the Staff,
who wiped out
the giant buds covering Derulla
in one fell swoop.

Even if those buds
were only a part of
the seed’s sealed power,
it was still the power of a demon.
Quelling it is no easy feat.

That is what makes it
the legendary Staff of Tikkun.

Being able to observe it up close
is the chance of a lifetime.

To think such a worthy
subject of research
would still be left
in this dull world...!

You’re late,
but you’ve passed.
I’ll at least acknowledge
your efforts not to make
me give up on
this world completely, God...
